blocks.text: Desktop platforms have different conventions after all windows close. Electron apps commonly keep running on macOS and recreate a window when activated.

Use a local Electron project with electron installed as a dev dependency and main.cjs as its main file. Run with npx electron . after creating package.json and index.html. These APIs do not run in a web-page playground.
